opportunities.name: Stellar Community Fund — Build Award Round #45
opportunities.summary: Apply to Stellar Community Fund Build Award round #45 for up to $150K in XLM across Open, Integration, and RFP tracks for projects building on Stellar and Soroban; submit the interest form before the July 26, 2026 submission deadline.
opportunities.fit_reason: concrete open round, fixed deadline and amount

opportunities.name: Filecoin Open Grants (devgrants)
opportunities.summary: Apply for up to $50,000 to build developer/data tooling, integrations, storage, retrieval, research, or FVM projects on Filecoin; submit a proposal as a GitHub issue, with preliminary review in ~2 weeks and a final decision generally within 4 weeks.
opportunities.fit_reason: open rolling program, clear cap and process

opportunities.name: Ethereum Foundation Ecosystem Support Program (ESP)
opportunities.summary: Apply for non-dilutive grants (typically $5K–$200K+) for open-source Ethereum infrastructure, cryptography, zero-knowledge proofs, developer tooling, education, and research; rolling Wishlist/RFP applications are reviewed within 3–6 weeks.
opportunities.fit_reason: active rolling program, broad eligibility, named amount range

opportunities.name: Zcash Community Grants (ZCG)
opportunities.amount: varies; funded from a ~100,000 ZEC Major Grants pool (~$11M)
opportunities.summary: Apply for funding from Zcash's ~100,000 ZEC Major Grants allocation (~$11M, running through the 2028 halving) to perform ongoing public-good development for the Zcash ecosystem; submit via GitHub issue template or propose against open RFPs.
opportunities.fit_reason: open rolling program with large funded pool

opportunities.name: Solana Foundation Grants

opportunities.fit_reason: confirmed rolling open program, amount unspecified

opportunities.name: Arbitrum Foundation Grant Program
